skills.name: requirements-analysis
skills.description: Executes the 需求收集与需求分析 phase workflow: stakeholder identification, requirement breakdown, traceability matrix, and handoff baseline (REQ prefix). Use when working in 01_req/**, or when the user mentions requirements analysis, REQ artifacts, acceptance criteria, scope boundaries, or ai-project-kit requirements phase.

skills.name: architecture-design
skills.description: Executes the 系统架构设计 phase workflow: architecture drivers, system boundaries, technical decisions, NFR strategies, and risk validation (ARCH prefix). Use when working in 02_build/playbook/01_architecture/** or 02_build/workspace/01_architecture/**, or when the user mentions system architecture, ARCH artifacts, integration boundaries, or NFR design.

skills.name: detailed-design
skills.description: Executes the 详细设计 phase workflow: module design, API contracts, state machines, exception handling, and design traceability (DES prefix). Use when working in 02_build/playbook/02_design/** or 02_build/workspace/02_design/**, or when the user mentions detailed design, DES artifacts, interface contracts, or state flows.

skills.name: database-design
skills.description: Executes the 数据库设计 phase workflow: data modeling, field dictionaries, indexes, migration scripts, and rollback planning (DB prefix). Use when working in 02_build/playbook/03_database/** or 02_build/workspace/03_database/**, or when the user mentions database design, DB artifacts, schema migration, or data modeling.

skills.name: codebase-implementation
skills.description: Executes the 代码实现与工程管理 phase workflow: dev task breakdown, implementation, testing evidence, code review, and handoff to QA/release (CODE prefix). Use when working in 02_build/playbook/04_codebase/** or 02_build/workspace/04_codebase/**, or when the user mentions code implementation, CODE artifacts, build/test records, or dev handoff.

skills.name: release-management
skills.description: Executes the 版本发布与迭代 phase workflow: release planning, deployment checklists, rollback preparation, release validation, and post-release review (REL prefix). Use when working in 02_build/playbook/05_release/** or 02_build/workspace/05_release/**, or when the user mentions release management, REL artifacts, deployment, or rollback.

skills.name: quality-assurance
skills.description: Executes the 测试与质量保证 phase workflow: test strategy, test cases, execution records, defect tracking, regression, and release recommendation (QA prefix). Use when working in 03_qa/playbook/01_testing/** or 03_qa/workspace/01_testing/**, or when the user mentions QA testing, test cases, defects, regression, or quality reports.

skills.name: change-management
skills.description: Executes the 变更与配置管理 phase workflow: change registration, impact analysis, approval tracking, implementation sync, and closure (CR prefix). Use when working in 03_qa/playbook/02_changes/** or 03_qa/workspace/02_changes/**, or when the user mentions change management, CR artifacts, impact analysis, or change approval.

skills.name: delivery-acceptance
skills.description: Executes the 项目交付与验收 phase workflow: delivery package, acceptance checklist, training materials, ops handoff, and legacy issue management (DEL prefix). Use when working in 04_delivery/**, or when the user mentions project delivery, acceptance, DEL artifacts, user manuals, or ops handoff.

skills.name: ai-governance
skills.description: Executes the AI 使用治理与质量约束 phase workflow: AI usage logging, prompt review, security checks, output acceptance, metrics, and retrospective (GOV prefix). Use when working in 05_gov/**, or when the user mentions AI governance, GOV artifacts, prompt review, AI audit, or compliance checks.
